how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate I Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Gandhinagar to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-I recruitment is 12th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I post at IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: Candidates need a B.Sc/B.C.A./B.Com/B.A or equivalent with at least 60% from graduation onwards and 55% in 10th and 12th, along with 4 years of post-qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Associate-I position ranges from Rs. 45,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What are the selection methods for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process will include a Written Test and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is OTH/1205/Advt0301 DATED 19.08.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where is IIT Gandhinagar located?
faq.answer: IIT Gandhinagar is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at IIT Gandhinagar.
